Name: Nyapu Style Lumen from Arknights by AhCuteArt
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[center] [size=5][b]Lumen from Arknights[/b][/size][b][size=5]- Nyapu Style by AhCuteArt[/size][/b][/center][b][size=5]

[/size][/b]
[b][size=5]
[/size][/b]I adore Nyapu's style portraits and custom NPCs. My passion project at the moment is to create Nyapu-style portraits for all the NPCs in my mega-modded SDV file. 

He's finally done! I used to love playing Arknights (when I was in my gocha game phase), and Lumen was one of my favs. Boy, was he a tough one to retexture. He had a lot of details I needed to reference, and I am still not sure if I got all of them. I had to guess on one of his Spirit Eve outfits. I had some issues coding him, but I finally figured it out (with help). Overall, though, I think he turned out great, and I am looking forward to romancing him soon. LOL.


[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30145]New NPC - Lumen from Arknights[/url]
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]There are Two files:[/b]
[Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. 

[b]
